scope: Personal review of the issued answer and all7 executed analysis requests, including recovery attempts. No future outcomes are present.

execution.failures: Mixed-type date inspection and missing parsed columns were recovered. Complete12302-row facts were available.

financial_review.finding: Quarterly seasonal fit is not reliable
financial_review.evidence: Single-quarter duration filter did not reconstruct Q4 from annual minus nine-month totals. It indexed observed rows contiguously with arange, even though quarters were missing, then projected a Q4 seasonal reference with no observed Q4. An earlier review found implausible Q4 revenue near$10M against other quarters near$500M.
financial_review.classification: data construction and model validation failure
financial_review.final_impact: Later annual/guidance-anchored calculation superseded this path; do not treat the intermediate fit as a valid model.

financial_review.finding: Posterior mean uncertainty is used as predictive uncertainty
financial_review.evidence: ModelC draws normal growth with sigma_post=1/sqrt(prior_precision+n*data_precision). This measures uncertainty in the mean growth parameter; it omits an additional future growth innovation.
financial_review.final_impact: Final revenue p10/p50/p90 of$1.50/$1.75/$2.05B are judgmentally widened; they are not demonstrated calibrated predictive quantiles.

financial_review.evidence: Annual models fit all available history and compare extrapolations; there is no forecast-origin holdout comparison with a baseline.

financial_review.finding: Return horizon has two extra increments
financial_review.evidence: Final code counts weekdays inclusively, removes Thanksgiving/Christmas/New Year but omits Martin Luther King Jr Day2027-01-18, and treats the entry session as a return increment. It samples62 daily returns.
financial_review.correct_target: Official NYSE2026/2027 calendars imply61 inclusive sessions and60 close-to-close increments from2026-10-23 close to2027-01-21 close.
financial_review.final_impact: Retain issued forecast and score the originally specified close-to-close dates; do not silently relabel its horizon.

strengths: Uses full frozen facts/prices and joint GH/SPY bootstrap rather than independent stock paths.
Recognizes guidance as an explicit business anchor and considers legal/commercial risks.
Recovers several tool failures and finishes before issue deadline.
acceptance: Useful completed investigation with material modeling and target-adherence problems; execution success does not establish forecasting quality.
